text: Traffic for trailers and semi-trailers is prohibited on the Nakerala Pass and the Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Shkmeri-Zudali road.

Due to snowfall, the movement of trailers and semi-trailers is temporarily prohibited on the km39-km60 section (Nakerala Pass) of the Kutaisi (Motsameta)-Tkibuli-Ambrolauri secondary road and on the Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Shkmeri-Zudali road.
The information is released by the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia. According to the same source, movement for other types of vehicles is unrestricted.
